# buzz

Vibrates the device in a short alert pattern, where it can (most Android phones; not iOS or desktops). Returns whether it did. Call it with `chime()`, so a phone on silent still gets the alert.

```tsx
import { buzz } from "@/registry/ouro/lib/ouro/feedback";
```

## Example

```tsx
buzz();
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |


## Returns

`boolean`
